Name: Fairy Aura
Effect: Increase 2 dice to all Damage Pools of Fairy-Type Moves of all Pokémon in the field. This effect does not stack. Pokémon and Trainers on the field will not attack the user of this Ability. Unique Ability.
Description: A powerful pink glowing aura comes out of this Pokémon, covering the field in a glimmering light, filling everyone's hearts with peace, hope, and love.
